name: flow_hub_boots_offline
description: The game boots into the hub, offline: the main scene is the hub, a first launch asks for a name prefilled with a generated one, and the party is one row (me, my Builder). Play is the one button, and it reaches a running offline match with my main Builder in under 300 frames.

steps.msg: the main scene is the hub, offline

steps.assert: node('NamePrompt').visible and node('NameField').text == Session.profile.player_name and Session.profile.player_name != ''
steps.msg: a first launch asks for a name, prefilled with a generated one
the strip says where the party lives: offline

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond %s lamplighter' % Session.profile.player_name, '+ invite', '+ invite', '+ invite']
steps.msg: a party of one: my row and three open ones
Play reaches a running match in under 300 frames
an offline match of one with my main
